name: Murder
overview: Scripture reveals that murder is a grievous sin originating from the heart, as seen in the tragic account of Cain who rose against and killed his brother Abel. God's response to Cain's act underscores the severity of taking a life, pronouncing a curse upon him and marking him as a fugitive on the earth. The blood of the slain cries out to God, emphasizing that murder disrupts the sanctity of human life and incurs divine judgment that is both just and severe.
